pretreatments.description: Subcritical water pretreatment: Hydrolysis of açai residue at 170 °C using 5.0 g of açai seed in a semi-continuous flow unit with a water flow rate of 20 mL min^-1 and a pressure of 15 MPa, maintained for 20 min, followed by analysis of pH values, reducing sugars, total reducing sugars, the composition of sugars, organic acids and inhibitors.

Subcritical water pretreatment: Hydrolysis of açai residue at 200 °C using 5.0 g of açai seed in a semi-continuous flow unit with a water flow rate of 20 mL min^-1 and a pressure of 15 MPa, maintained for 20 min, followed by analysis of pH values, reducing sugars, total reducing sugars, the composition of sugars, organic acids and inhibitors.

Anaerobic digestion: Control reactor with açai seed and wastewater from açai fruit processing, high solids content (25% of total solids and 75% of liquid, where 30% of the liquid was mesophilic sludge, and the remaining was wastewater of açai processing).
Anaerobic digestion: Integration reactor with hydrolyzed açai seed and wastewater from açai fruit processing, low solids content (70% hydrolyzed and 30% mesophilic sludge).
